Order a Religious Hymn The minstrel will perform a song about how Mother Sophia punished a sinner, and he, having found faith, was cleansed of his sins, after which a miracle was revealed to him. Effect: {number} listeners will become religious fanatics. Cost: {cost_rings}

Order a Lyrical Poem The minstrel will perform a touching story of love, devotion, and simple happiness. The heartfelt lines accompanied by the gentle strumming of strings will soothe the souls of the listeners. Effect: {number} listeners will receive a positive thought. Cost: {cost_rings}

Order a Heroic Song The minstrel will tell of the feats of ancestors and the trials to come, inspiring those who are ready to challenge fate and give their lives for the king. Effect: {number} listeners will become loyalists. Cost: {cost_rings}

Order a Moral Tale The minstrel will tell a cautionary tale of a simple peasant who tried to gain wealth by dishonest means, only to meet his end at the gallows. His wife and children were inconsolable. Effect: {number} vagabonds or cutthroats will decide to return to the honest life of a peasant. Cost: {cost_rings}

Give the Dog
Give the dog to this lord. He will become its new owner.

Tame the Dog
This dog has no owner, so you can tame it and it will become the chosen lord’s pet.

Minstrel
A wandering minstrel visits your town. Common folk love the songs and stories of minstrels and believe everything they sing about.

For a modest fee, he is ready to perform any song you order to influence the listeners.

Sudden Death
News has reached you that the character {soul_uuid_target} has passed away.

It is said that they suddenly felt ill during lunch, and by evening, they had departed for another world.

Everything appeared natural, but it seems as if the priest Dahamat fulfilled his part of the bargain.

Incognito
A character in disguise is visiting your city. They will stay for a few days.

No one knows their real name, but their manners and clothing suggest noble origins.

As unclear as their identity are their intentions, which could be either good or bad, and the only way to find out is to wait.

Or, you can expel them at any time, without waiting to uncover their secret.

Unable to summon
An uprising is expected soon in the city of {faction_uuid}, so the ruler does not want the warriors to leave the province.
